description: Move your unread cursor forward without reading the skipped messages, for example after catch_me_up (which does not move it), so receive_unread_messages returns only newer ones. Skipped messages stay readable with list_messages. Forward only: a to_seq behind your cursor or past the latest fails 400. Not idempotent.

to_seq.description: Space sequence number to move your unread cursor to; default the latest. Forward only.

name: fast_forward
title: Fast-forward unread cursor
